roles.title: Community & Outreach Associate
roles.summary: Grow Peak's presence across the internet, and set up collaborations with media and influencers.
responsibilities: Post about Peak across X, Reddit and Facebook.
Respond to queries and reviews across platforms.
Track trends in the astrology world and feed them back into what we publish.
Reach out to traditional and social media outlets, and to influencers, to set up collaborations and interactions on their platforms or on Peak's.
lookingFor: A mature approach to public conversations, including critical ones.
Initiative: much of this role is outreach you start yourself.
Comfortable on X, Reddit and Facebook as a participant, not just a reader.
whatYouGet: Ownership of Peak's public voice across platforms.
Direct working relationship with the founders.
roles.sampleHint: A thread, post or campaign you wrote and shipped.

roles.title: Campaign Creatives Associate
roles.summary: Build Peak's bank of campaign creative: images, video and collateral used across campaigns.
responsibilities: Create image and video collateral for Peak campaigns.
Build and maintain a reusable creative bank.
Work assets to the Peak brand system (type, colour, mark).
Turn campaign briefs into finished pieces.
lookingFor: Strong hands-on skill with Canva, Higgsfield or comparable image and video tools.
An eye for restraint: Peak is warm and spare, not busy.
whatYouGet: A portfolio of shipped campaign work.
Direct working relationship with the founders.
roles.sampleHint: A portfolio link works, or attach two or three finished pieces.

roles.title: Writer, Articles & Research
roles.summary: Write researched articles for the Peak website, published under your own name.
responsibilities: Research your subject properly before you write.
Work from your own reading and knowledge.
lookingFor: Relevant cultural background and real familiarity with the subject matter.
A passion for writing, and work that shows it.
Writers who write themselves. We do not accept AI-generated copy.
whatYouGet: A byline on every article you write, credited on the website.
Published credentials you keep and can point to.
roles.sampleHint: One piece you wrote yourself, published or not.
